highlights: Fixed cross-reading of quota between multiple accounts: quota queries are bound to the browser page of the corresponding account, preventing wrong balances and usage from being shown across accounts.
When reading quota fails or returns no valid data, the old cache is kept and the failure is reported explicitly, so invalid results are not treated as live quota.
Fixed false keep-alive success reports: a wake request being accepted is now distinguished from the VM actually running; wake success is only reported when the re-checked status is RUNNING.
The admin page shows the quota query time and a staleness warning; account tests report session validity and quota read status separately.

Maintenance probes no longer update the last-used time, and background keep-alive runs only when renewal is needed, so maintenance traffic is not counted as user activity or triggers keep-alive too often.
Added offline regression tests covering per-account quota isolation and VM wake status confirmation.
Quota lookup now supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English UIs, including full-width characters, decimal percentages and 0% usage.
Fixed quota panel locating and closing flow; when no valid quota is read, the old cache is kept and invalid results are no longer treated as live data.
The admin page shows a clear HTTP status message for non-JSON errors, avoiding leaking HTML error pages returned by proxies.
